Abstract base class for a node-graph data model in QtNodes. It defines the CRUD and query interface for nodes, ports, and connections, emits Qt signals for view updates, and provides helpers for port insertion/deletion workflows. Intended to be subclassed; no direct constructors are provided here. Ownership details of other types are not defined in this header.

Abstract base class for computing and querying node geometry within the QtNodes framework. Provides pure-virtual APIs for sizes, positions of ports, captions, widgets, and resize handles, with a concrete helper for scene-transformed port position. Holds a reference to an AbstractGraphModel that supplies model data. Must be subclassed and implemented by backends to define layout and hit-testing. Construction requires an AbstractGraphModel reference; destruction is virtual.

Abstract base class (exported with NODE_EDITOR_PUBLIC) for providing custom node painting within the QtNodes framework. Subclass this and override paint() to draw using a QPainter given the target NodeGraphicsObject. Pure virtual; cannot be instantiated directly.

QGraphicsScene subclass managing visual nodes and connections for a node editor. It owns NodeGraphicsObject and ConnectionGraphicsObject instances mapped by NodeId/ConnectionId, holds strategy objects for geometry and painting, provides undo stack access, emits interaction signals, and supports a temporary draft connection during interactive link creation. Construction requires an AbstractGraphModel reference; scenes without a model are disallowed.

A Qt graphics object representing a connection between nodes in a node editor. It derives from QGraphicsObject and integrates with a BasicGraphicsScene and an AbstractGraphModel. It stores a ConnectionId, manages connection state, and provides geometry, painting, mouse/hover handling, and utilities for endpoints and Bezier control points. Construction requires a BasicGraphicsScene and a ConnectionId. Destruction is defaulted. Internal ownership/responsibility details for model/scene are not specified in this header.

A state holder for a connection being interacted with in the QtNodes editor. Tracks whether a connection end is loose (enum LooseEnd), current hover state, and the last hovered node ID. Holds a reference to the associated ConnectionGraphicsObject. Copy and move are disabled; it has a non-inline destructor declared here. Methods query required port type, whether a port is required, manage hover state, and cache/reset the last hovered node. Details of PortType, NodeId, and InvalidNodeId come from other headers and are not defined here.

A QtNodes style class that configures visual attributes for node-connection rendering, including colors (construction, normal, selected, halo, hovered), line widths, point diameter, and whether colors come from data. It inherits from Style (declared elsewhere) and provides JSON load/save plus a static method to set the global connection style from JSON text. Ownership is typically by higher-level editor components that keep a ConnectionStyle as a member; not specified here.

A Qt-based graphics scene for dataflow graphs, derived from BasicGraphicsScene. It integrates with a DataFlowGraphModel to manage node/edge data propagation and provides selection querying, a context menu factory, save/load slots, and a sceneLoaded signal. Construction requires a DataFlowGraphModel reference and optional QObject parent. Destruction is defaulted. Details of behavior are inferred; exact semantics depend on the referenced model and base class.

Concrete graph model implementing data-flow semantics for a node editor. Inherits AbstractGraphModel and Serializable, integrates with Qt (signals/slots) to manage nodes, ports, and connections, persistence to/from JSON, and geometry metadata. Construction requires a NodeDelegateModelRegistry shared_ptr. Destruction/ownership: owns NodeDelegateModel instances in _models; geometry stored in _nodeGeometryData; connections tracked in _connectivity. External dependent types (NodeId, ConnectionId, PortType, etc.) are declared elsewhere.
Simple POD carrying per-node geometry: the rendered size and position. Used internally by DataFlowGraphModel as mutable cache/state in _nodeGeometryData. QSize and QPointF are Qt types.

QtNodes::GraphicsView is a central QGraphicsView-derived widget for rendering and interacting with a BasicGraphicsScene. It provides zooming (with a configurable ScaleRange where 0/0 means unlimited), panning and selection management, actions for clear/delete/duplicate/copy/paste, and signals/slots for scale changes. Constructors allow creating with or without an initial BasicGraphicsScene. Copy operations are disabled. Ownership semantics: it stores a pointer to a BasicGraphicsScene via setScene/nodeScene but the header does not specify ownership or lifetime management details.

A simple POD nested in QtNodes::GraphicsView that defines the allowable scaling range for the view. minimum and maximum are zoom bounds; both set to 0 indicate no limit in that direction according to the comment. Used by GraphicsView to constrain zooming.

A QtNodes style class that specializes Style to hold visual parameters for a graphics view, specifically background and grid colors. It can be constructed with default parameters or from a JSON string and provides JSON load/serialize hooks. Public color members suggest direct read/write configuration. Details of Style base class and NODE_EDITOR_PUBLIC macro are external to this header.

Forward-declared class representing a graphics object for a node within the QtNodes namespace. Only an incomplete declaration is present in this header; its internal structure and ownership semantics are unknown here.

Note: This is not a type; included here only because no other custom fully-defined types exist in the header. There is no constructor function defined for NodeGraphicsObject in this header.

A simple value type describing a node-port data category. The id uniquely identifies the data type for matching/compatibility checks, while name is a human-readable label. Registered with Qt's meta-type system for QVariant usage.

Abstract base class for payload objects transferred between nodes. Derived classes store concrete data and must implement type() to return their NodeDataType. sameType compares two instances by their type().id. Registered with Qt's meta-type system as std::shared_ptr<NodeData> for signal/slot and QVariant transport.

Struct encapsulating validation status for a node, including a tri-state enum (Valid/Warning/Error) and an optional explanatory message. Provides helpers to query validity, current state, and message. Used by NodeDelegateModel to report configuration status.
Scoped enum inside QtNodes::NodeValidationState representing validation levels: Valid, Warning, Error.
Scoped enum describing a node's current processing status for UI/logic (e.g., NoStatus, Updated, Processing, Pending, Empty, Failed, Partial).

Abstract base class for node data models that integrate with the QtNodes graph framework. Inherits QObject and Serializable. Implementers must provide port counts/types, data I/O, metadata (name/caption), and an optional embedded QWidget. Exposes validation and processing status, style control, and Qt signals/slots for graph interactions. Constructed via public default constructor; intended for subclassing rather than direct instantiation.

A Qt graphics item representing a node within a node editor scene. It subclasses QGraphicsObject and integrates with the graph model to manage a node's visual representation, state, and interaction (painting, hover, mouse, context menu). It tracks its NodeId, owns a NodeState, and may host an embedded QWidget via QGraphicsProxyWidget. Details like NodeId type and ConnectionGraphicsObject are referenced but defined elsewhere.

QtNodes::NodeState is a GUI-related state holder for a node. It tracks whether the node is hovered, whether it is currently being resized, and which ConnectionGraphicsObject (if any) is being tracked for a pending interaction (“reaction”). It owns no heavy resources; it references the associated NodeGraphicsObject and keeps a QPointer to a ConnectionGraphicsObject so it auto-nullifies when the QObject is destroyed. Construction requires a NodeGraphicsObject reference; lifecycle and memory management are external to this class. Destruction details are not specified here.
Strongly-typed enum describing where a node's processing status icon is drawn within the node UI: bottom-left or bottom-right.

Struct grouping visual parameters for a processing/status icon on a node: its position, rendered size in device units, margin from edges, and icon rasterization resolution. Defaults place a 20px icon at bottom-right with 8px margin and 64px source resolution.

Style configuration class for nodes in the QtNodes UI, derived from Style. It loads/saves style from JSON, exposes colors, pen widths, opacity, connection point sizes, tooltip and status icons, and an embedded ProcessingIconStyle. Construction is via default or from JSON text/object; Style base class semantics (lifetime, ownership) are external to this header.

Abstract interface-like base class in QtNodes for types that can be serialized to and from QJsonObject. Provides a virtual destructor, a default save() returning an empty object, and a default load() that ignores its input. Intended to be subclassed; subclasses should override save() and load() to provide actual serialization logic. No ownership semantics or members are defined here.

Abstract base class in namespace QtNodes representing a style configuration that can be serialized to and from JSON. It defines pure virtual methods to load from a QJsonObject and to emit a QJsonObject. It also provides concrete helpers to load from UTF-8 byte arrays, text, and files. Intended to be subclassed; the subclass implements loadJson and toJson. Destruction is via virtual destructor. No ownership or construction helpers are provided here.

Singleton-style manager class that stores and provides access to style objects used by the node editor (NodeStyle, ConnectionStyle, GraphicsViewStyle). Construction is private; copying and assignment are disabled. Access is via static getters and setters that forward to an internal singleton instance. Ownership: it directly contains NodeStyle, ConnectionStyle, and GraphicsViewStyle as member fields. Lifetime and construction details of the singleton instance are not shown in this header and likely implemented in the source file.

Concrete painter for connection graphics in the QtNodes namespace. It specializes AbstractConnectionPainter to render connections (normal, hovered/selected, and sketch lines) and to compute the painter stroke path. Only the interface is present here; implementation details are elsewhere. Construction is default (no ctor declared) and it has no data members; usage is via calling its virtual methods with a QPainter and a ConnectionGraphicsObject reference. Any ownership or lifetime is managed by callers; no special destruction required.

Concrete node-geometry implementation for horizontally laid-out nodes in the QtNodes framework. It derives from AbstractNodeGeometry and provides sizing, bounding, port positions, caption/widget placement, and resize-handle geometry for a node. It maintains cached/mutable drawing metrics such as port size and font metrics. Construction requires an AbstractGraphModel reference. Details like NodeId, PortType, and PortIndex originate from included headers and are not defined here.

Concrete painter implementation within QtNodes that encapsulates all painting routines for a node's graphics object. It derives from AbstractNodePainter and provides rendering of node rectangle, connection points (filled and unfilled), caption, entry labels, resize handle, processing indicator, and validation icon. Internally holds a tooltip icon resource. Construction is default (no explicit constructor defined here); lifetime and destruction follow standard C++ class semantics. Details of AbstractNodePainter and NodeGraphicsObject are external to this header.

Concrete node-geometry policy implementing a vertical layout for nodes in the QtNodes framework. It derives from AbstractNodeGeometry and computes bounding rects, sizes, port positions, caption/widget placement, and resize-handle geometry. It caches font-related metrics and port size for efficient, const-correct queries. Construction requires an AbstractGraphModel reference. Detailed behavior depends on AbstractNodeGeometry and related model types; destruction is default. Note: BasicGraphicsScene is forward-declared here but not used as a member.

A utility class in QtNodes that encapsulates the logic for validating and performing node-connection interactions in a scene. It operates on existing NodeGraphicsObject and ConnectionGraphicsObject instances within a BasicGraphicsScene to check whether a connection can be made, attempt the connection, or disconnect an existing one. Construction requires references to the involved graphics objects and scene; instances are intended for short-lived, stack-based use. Implementation details (ownership, lifetime rules, error handling) are not present in this header.

Undoable command that creates a node in a BasicGraphicsScene at a given mouse scene position. Stores the created node id and a serialized scene snapshot to support undo/redo. Details of serialization and node creation are defined elsewhere.
Undoable command that deletes currently selected scene objects from a BasicGraphicsScene, serializing them first so they can be restored on undo. Redo re-applies the deletion.
Command that copies selected objects from a BasicGraphicsScene to the clipboard. As defined here, it carries no undo/redo behavior in the header; implementation likely performs copy on construction.

Undoable command that pastes previously copied scene content into a BasicGraphicsScene at/near the given mouse scene position. It reads scene JSON from the clipboard, remaps node IDs, and stores the new scene JSON for undo/redo.
Undoable command that removes a connection identified by ConnectionId from a BasicGraphicsScene. Undo recreates the connection; redo removes it again.
Undoable command that creates a connection identified by ConnectionId in a BasicGraphicsScene. Undo removes it; redo recreates it.
Undoable command that moves selected nodes in a BasicGraphicsScene by a delta. Supports command compression via id() and mergeWith() to merge consecutive move operations.

import random
import string
from typing import List

def _rand_bool(r: random.Random) -> bool:
    return bool(r.getrandbits(1))

# Build a small corpus of plausible JSON style texts used by various Style::set* and loadJson paths
_DEF_STYLE_JSONS: List[str] = [

    "{}",

    # Alternate palette
    '{"ConstructionColor":"#00ffcc","NormalColor":"#333333","SelectedColor":"#ff3333","SelectedHaloColor":"#ffee00","HoveredColor":"#00aaff","LineWidth":1.25,"ConstructionLineWidth":2.5,"PointDiameter":4.0,"UseDataDefinedColors":true}',
    # GraphicsViewStyle guess
    '{"BackgroundColor":"#20262c","FineGridColor":"#2a3440","CoarseGridColor":"#3a4756"}',

    '{"NormalBoundaryColor":"#555555","SelectedBoundaryColor":"#ffaa00","GradientColor0":"#2b2b2b","GradientColor1":"#3a3a3a","GradientColor2":"#4a4a4a","GradientColor3":"#5a5a5a","ShadowColor":"#000000","ShadowEnabled":true,"FontColor":"#eeeeee","FontColorFaded":"#aaaaaa","ConnectionPointColor":"#8888ff","FilledConnectionPointColor":"#4444aa","WarningColor":"#ffcc00","ErrorColor":"#ff0044","ToolTipIconColor":"#ffffff","PenWidth":1.0,"HoveredPenWidth":1.5,"ConnectionPointDiameter":8.0,"Opacity":0.95}',

# Some plausible node type names for AbstractGraphModel::addNode
_NODE_TYPES = [

    "TextureLoader", "Image", "Color", "Threshold", "Blend", "Noise"
]

# Helper to create a valid hex color string
_def_hex_colors = ["#000000", "#ffffff", "#ff0000", "#00ff00", "#0000ff", "#ffaa00", "#00ffaa", "#aa00ff"]


def _rand_hex_color(r: random.Random) -> str:
    if _rand_bool(r):
        return r.choice(_def_hex_colors)
    # random color
    return "#" + "".join(f"{r.randrange(256):02x}" for _ in range(3))


def _json_conn_style(r: random.Random) -> str:
    obj = {
        "ConstructionColor": _rand_hex_color(r),
        "NormalColor": _rand_hex_color(r),
        "SelectedColor": _rand_hex_color(r),
        "SelectedHaloColor": _rand_hex_color(r),
        "HoveredColor": _rand_hex_color(r),
        "LineWidth": round(r.uniform(0.1, 8.0), 2),

    keys = [

    parts = []
    for k in keys:

        elif isinstance(v, bool):
            parts.append(f'"{k}":{str(v).lower()}')
        else:

def _random_node_type(r: random.Random) -> str:
    base = r.choice(_NODE_TYPES)

        base += str(r.randrange(0, 10))

def _unicode_mixture(r: random.Random, min_len: int = 3, max_len: int = 40) -> str:
    # Create a valid UTF-8 text mixing ASCII and some extended Unicode
    ascii_pool = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + " _-:/#"
    extras = [
        "α", "β", "γ", "δ", "Ω", "π", "λ", "漢", "字", "テ", "ス", "ト",
        "✓", "•", "→", "∞", "😀", "🔥",
    ]
    n = r.randint(min_len, max_len)
    s = []
    for _ in range(n):
        if r.random() < 0.85:
            s.append(r.choice(ascii_pool))
        else:
            s.append(r.choice(extras))
    return "".join(s)


def _build_composite_blob(r: random.Random) -> str:
    # Compose a multi-section UTF-8 text that the stubs will consume in various places
    sections: List[str] = []

    # 1) One or more JSON style blobs for setConnectionStyle / GraphicsViewStyle::setStyle / NodeStyle::setNodeStyle
    json_variants = [_json_conn_style(r), _json_view_style(r), _json_node_style(r)] + _DEF_STYLE_JSONS
    r.shuffle(json_variants)
    count_json = r.randint(2, 4)
    sections.extend(json_variants[:count_json])

    # 2) Several plausible node type names used by addNode
    node_types = ",".join(_random_node_type(r) for _ in range(r.randint(2, 5)))
    sections.append(node_types)

    # 3) Captions and miscellaneous strings for setNodeData/portData
    for _ in range(r.randint(2, 4)):
        sections.append(_unicode_mixture(r, 5, 24))

    # 4) Short valid JSON objects used by Style::loadJson paths when parsing succeeds
    for _ in range(r.randint(1, 2)):
        mini = '{"foo":true,"bar":"' + _unicode_mixture(r, 3, 8).replace('"', '') + '"}'
        sections.append(mini)

    # Join with separators so each FUZZ_PARAM_STR() draw will likely get a coherent piece
    blob = "\n\n".join(sections)

    # Bound total size to <= 4096 bytes
    b = blob.encode('utf-8')
    if len(b) > 4096:
        # trim at character boundary by re-slicing string proportionally
        keep = max(1024, int(len(blob) * 4096 / len(b)))
        blob = blob[:keep]
        # final guard
        blob = blob.encode('utf-8')[:4096].decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
    return blob


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    # Build a composite corpus text that is highly likely to be valid UTF-8 and useful across stubs
    text = _build_composite_blob(r)
    # Return bytes as required; QString::fromUtf8 will accept these
    return text.encode('utf-8')
